jsonld.headline: RS Medium - Non-Nutrient Medium (NNM) Component
labEquipmentUsed: DURAN screw cap GL45 with 2 hose connections
jsonld.protocolPurpose: Prepare the solution RS Medium - Non-Nutrient Medium (NNM) Component for the cultivation of microorganisms.

cells: Na2SiO3 x 5 H2O (Stock solution 0.053g/50mL; prepare by stirring continuously to promote the dissolution of silicon)
BaCO3 (Stock solution 1mg/ml. Heavy metal. Filter by using 0.22 µm pore size (do not autoclave). Store in the dark)
Cd(NO3)2 x 4 H2O (Stock solution 1mg/mL. Heavy metal. Store in the dark)
PbCl2 (Stock solution 1mg/mL. Heavy metal. Store in the dark)
AgNO3 (Stock solution 1mg/mL. Heavy metal. Store in the dark)
TiCl3 (Stock solution. Heavy metal. Use Sigma-Aldrich ref. 14010 (10-15% TiCl3 basis) and dilute 1:1000000. Store in the dark)

2 Ingredient phase: For the ingredients indicated with "Stock solution", prepare stock solutions in H2O at the specified concentration and autoclave to sterilize (except for the stock solution of BaCO3, which should be filter sterilized with a 0.22 µm pore size). Store stock solutions at room temperature (RT). Heavy metal stock solutions should be stored in the dark at RT.
3 Ingredient phase: In a 2 liter bottle, combine the indicated amount of each solid ingredient or liquid stock solution.
4 Ingredient phase: Fill to a total volume of 1 liter with purified H2O.

5 Sparging apparatus assembly phase (optional): We have found that directly autoclaving the sparging apparatus materials after assembly (step 12 below) can result in small particles from the materials entering the liquid. These particles mimic the appearance of precipitates that might result from autoclaving the liquid, making it difficult to distinguish between particles from the materials (which could be filtered out) versus precipitates (which are to be avoided). To prevent the accumulation of these particles, we autoclave all sparging apparatus materials (and let them dry and cool) before beginning assembly in the next step.
6 Sparging apparatus assembly phase: Replace the normal cap of the 2 liter bottle with a GL45 screw cap (which has two pass-through connections for flexible plastic tubes).

7 Sparging apparatus assembly phase: Attach a plastic tube to one of the connections on the inside of the cap. The tube should be long enough such that one end reaches inside the liquid in the bottle. This will be the tube through which CO2 and air will flow into the liquid.

8 Sparging apparatus assembly phase: Still working on the inflow of CO2/air, attach a short piece of plastic tubing to the corresponding connector on the top of the cap, and insert an 0.1 µm autoclavable filter into the tube.

9 Sparging apparatus assembly phase: Still working on the inflow of CO2/air, attach another small piece of plastic tubing to the open end of the 0.1 µm filter from the previous step. Attach an autoclavable filter with 0.2 µm pore size to this tube.

10 Sparging apparatus assembly phase: Still working on the inflow of CO2/air, attach a long piece of plastic tubing to the open end of the 0.2 µm filter from the previous step. This tube will attach to the supply of CO2 or air in the sparging step.

11 Sparging apparatus assembly phase: Changing to work on the outflow of excess CO2/air, attach a small piece of plastic tubing to the connection on the top of the cap. Attach an autoclavable filter with 0.2 µm pore size to this tube.
12 Autoclave the 2 liter bottle, containing 1 liter of liquid, with the attached sparging apparatus. Let sit until cool.
13 Sparge CO2 and air phase: Connect the long plastic inflow tube to a source of CO2 and sparge for 4h.
14 Sparge CO2 and air phase: Disconnect the tube from the CO2 source and connect to an air pump. Sparge for 12-24h to remove excess CO2.
15 Sparge CO2 and air phase: Disconnect from the air pump. Working in sterile conditions, replace the sparging apparatus with a sterile non-vented cap. Store at RT.

16 (Optional) Create agar plates with RS medium: for cultures that grow on solid media. Add desired percentage of agar (for example, 1.2%) to Non-Nutrient Medium (NNM) component from the previous step, autoclave again to sterilize and melt the agar, let cool for several minutes, add desired concentration of Nutrient Medium (NM) component (see corresponding recipe on MediaDive), mix and pour into plates.
17 Acknowledgements: We would like to thank Ben Temperton (University of Exteter) for fundamental advice and ideas in the creation of RS medium.
Autoclave, Autoclavable bottles, DURAN screw cap GL45 with 2 hose connections, Plastic tubes, CO2 pump, EHEIM Air pump 400, Autoclavable 0.1 µm and 0.22 µm filters

jsonld.headline: RS Medium - Nutrient Medium (NM) Component
jsonld.protocolPurpose: Prepare the solution RS Medium - Nutrient Medium (NM) Component for the cultivation of microorganisms.

cells: Na2SiO3 x 5 H2O (Single stock in H2O. Autoclave and store at RT.)
FeCl3 x 6 H2O (Single stock in H2O. Autoclave and store at RT.)
Na2EDTA x 2H2O (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at RT.)
NaNO3 (Single stock in NNM. Filter and store at RT.)
NaH2PO4 x H2O (Single stock in NNM. Filter and store at RT.)
K2HPO4 (Single stock in H2O. Filter and store at RT.)
NH4Cl (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at RT.)
Thiamine HCl (B1) (Single stock in H2O. Filter and store at -20C.)
Biotin (B8) (Single stock in H2O. Filter and store at -20C.)
Cyanocobalamin (B12) (Single stock in H2O. Filter and store at -20C.)
Folic acid (B9) (Single stock in H2O. Filter and store at -20C.)
Pyridoxine (B6) (Single stock in H2O. Filter and store at -20C.)
Riboflavin (B2) (Single stock in H2O. Filter and store at -20C.)
Niacin (B3) (Single stock in H2O. Filter and store at -20C.)
D-pantothenate acid hemicalcium salt (B5) (Single stock in H2O. Filter and store at -20C.)
Myo-Inositol (B7) (Single stock in H2O. Filter and store at -20C.)
4-Aminobenzoic Acid (Single stock in H2O. Filter and store at -20C.)
L-Glutamine (Single stock in H2O. Autoclave and store at -20C.)
Glycerol (Add directly to Mix solution 5 (Carbon Sources))
Sodium pyruvate (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at 4C in the dark.)
D-Glucose (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at 4C.)
N-acetyl-D-glucosamine (Single stock in H2O. Autoclave and store at -20C.)
D-Ribose (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at 4C.)
Sodium succinate (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at RT.)
y-aminobutyric acid (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at -20C.)
Sodium acetate (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at RT.)
Decanoic acid (Single stock in H2O. Autoclave and store at RT.)
L-Arabinose (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at 4C.)
L-Rhamnose (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at 4C.)
Fucose (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at 4C.)
D-Mannose (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at 4C.)
Galactose (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at 4C.)
D-Xylose (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at 4C.)
Sodium alginate (Single stock in H2O. Autoclave and store at 4C.)
Guanosine (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at -20C.)
Uracil (Single stock in NNM. Autoclave and store at -20C.)
MEM 50X Amino Acids solution (Sigma) (Add directly to Mix solution 4 (Amino Acids))
MEM 100X Amino Acids solution (Sigma) (Add directly to Mix solution 4 (Amino Acids))

2 Single stock phase: Prepare the single stocks as reported above. Single stocks are prepared either in purified H2O or in the Non-Nutrient Medium (NNM) component of RS Medium (see accompanying protocol on MediaDive). Filtration is performed with a 0.22 µm pore size.

3 Single stock phase: Notes for Methyl cellulose: prepare the single stock in H2O. It is known that Methyl cellulose is soluble in cold water and insoluble in hot water. In order to prepare this stock, add the relative amount and shake the single stock from time to time for 20 minutes. Leave the stock in cold water overnight. Its color should be white. The day after, after autoclaving, it will result like a white solid, not liquid. Leave it at RT until it becomes liquid and transparent. Store at 4C.
4 Single stock phase: Notes for Pectin: prepare the single stock in H2O. To dissolve, use a hot plate heater with a magnetic stirrer for 20 minutes before autoclaving. Store at 4C.

5 Mix solutions phase: Mix solution 1 (Si and Fe+EDTA): add 2.27 ml each from the single stocks of Na2SiO3*5H2O, FeCl3*6H2O and Na2EDTA*2H2O. Fill to 50 ml with NNM. Filter via syringe through a 0.22 µm pore size. Store at 4C.

6 Mix solutions phase: Mix solution 2 (NO3-PO4): add 2.27 ml each from the single stocks of NaNO3, NaH2PO4*H2O, K2HPO4 and NH4Cl. Fill to 50 ml with NNM. Filter via syringe through a 0.22 µm pore size. Prepare this mix fresh every time.

7 Mix solutions phase: Mix solution 3 (Vitamins): add 4.5 µl each from the single stocks of vitamins (Thiamine HCl (B1), Biotin (B8), Cyanocobalamin (B12), Folic acid (Folate) (B9), Pyridoxine (B6), Riboflavin (B2), Niacin (B3), D-pantothenate acid hemicalcium salt (B5), Myo-Inositol (B7) and 4-Aminobenzoic acid). Fill to 50 ml with NNM. Filter via syringe through a 0.22 µm pore size. Store at 4C.

8 Mix solutions phase: Mix solution 4 (Amino Acids): add 2.25 ml from the MEM 50X Amino Acids solution from Sigma and 2.27 ml from the MEM 100X Amino Acids solution from Sigma. Add 2.27 ml of the single stock of Glutamine. Fill to 50 ml with NNM. Filter via syringe through a 0.22 µm pore size. Store at 4C. NOTES: The MEM 50X AA solution contains Arginine (6.32 g/L), Cysteine HCl (1.56 g/L), Histidine (2.10 g/L), L-Isoleucine (2.63 g/L), L-Leucine (2.62 g/L), Lysine HCl (3.63 g/L), L-Methionine (0.76 g/L), L-Phenylalanine (1.65 g/L), L-Threonine (2.38 g/L), L-Tryptophan (0.51 g/L), L-Tyrosine (1.80 g/L) and L-Valine (2.34 g/L). The MEM 100X AA solution contains L-Alanine (0.89 g/L), Glycine (0.75 g/L), L-Proline (1.15 g/L), L-Asparagine*H2O (1.50 g/L), Aspartate (1.33 g/L), Glutamate (1.47 g/L), Serine (1.05 g/L).

9 Mix solutions phase: Mix solution 5 (Carbon Sources): add 45 µl of Glycerol from Sigma (1.26 g/mL). Add 2.27 ml of each carbon source (Sodium pyruvate, D-glucose, N-acetyI-D-glucosamine, D-ribose, Sodium succinate, y-aminobutyric acid, Sodium acetate, Decanoic acid, L-arabinose, L-rhamnose, Fucose, L-mannose, Galactose, Xylan, Sodium alginate, Methyl-cellulose, Pectin, Guanosine and Uracil). Fill to 50 ml with NNM. Filter through a 0.22 µm pore size by using the vacuum filter (not by syringe) because the solution is viscous. Store at 4C.

10 Final phase: Combine 4 ml of Mix solution 1 (Si and Fe+EDTA), 30 ml from Mix solution 2 (NO3-PO4), 10.7 ml from Mix solution 3 (Vitamins), 10.9 ml of Mix solution 4 (Amino Acids) and 10.7 ml of Mix solution 5 (Carbon sources). Fill to 150 ml with NNM. Filter through a 0.22 µm pore size by using a vacuum filter. Store Nutrient Medium 1.0 (NM 1.0) component at 4C.
11 Acknowledgements: We would like to thank Ben Temperton (University of Exteter) for fundamental advice and ideas in the creation of RS medium.
Autoclave, Autoclavable bottles, 0.22 µm vaccum filters, 0.22 µm syringe filters, 50 ml conical tubes

cells: 1 Preparación del Medio de Cultivo Preparar los siguientes Materiales y Equipos Necesarios - Agua destilada - NaCl (cloruro de sodio) - CaCl2 x 2 H2O (cloruro de calcio dihidratado) - NaHCO3 (bicarbonato de sodio) - Buffer de fosfato - Na2S2O4 (ditionito de sodio) - ZnSO4 x 7 H2O (sulfato de zinc heptahidratado) - FeSO4 x 7 H2O (sulfato de hierro heptahidratado) - MnCl2 x 4 H2O (cloruro de manganeso tetrahidratado) - CuSO4 x 5 H2O (sulfato de cobre pentahidratado) - CuCl2 (cloruro de cobre) - Fe(III)NH4-EDTA (complejo de hierro III con EDTA) - (NH4)2MoO4 (molibdato de amonio) - Balanzas - Vaso de precipitados - Agitador magnético - Autoclave - Frascos estériles

2 **Preparación de la Solución Base:** 2.1. **Medir 1 litro de agua destilada** y verterla en un vaso de precipitados grande. 2.2. **Añadir 25 g de NaCl** a la agua y agitar hasta que se disuelva completamente. 2.3. **Añadir 0.5 g de CaCl2 x 2 H2O** a la solución y agitar hasta que se disuelva completamente. 2.4. **Añadir 0.2 g de NaHCO3** a la solución y agitar hasta disolver. 2.5. **Añadir 4 g de buffer de fosfato** a la solución y agitar hasta disolver.

3 **Preparación de Agentes Reductores y Elementos Traza:** 3.1 - *Añadir 0.5 g de Na2S2O4** a la solución y agitar hasta disolver. 3.2.- **Preparar una solución de elementos traza**: 3.3 - **ZnSO4 x 7 H2O**: Pesar 0.05 g. 3.4- **FeSO4 x 7 H2O**: Pesar 0.01 g. 3.5- **MnCl2 x 4 H2O**: Pesar 0.05 g. 3.6- **CuSO4 x 5 H2O**: Pesar 0.05 g. 3.7- **CuCl2**: Pesar 0.01 g. 3.8- **Fe(III)NH4-EDTA**: Pesar 0.05 g. 3.9- **(NH4)2MoO4**: Pesar 0.005 g.
Alvarez Maqueda Rafael Alejandro Uriel (Cleto Gutierrez Miriam Rebeka)
Alvarez Maqueda Rafael Alejandro Uriel, Cleto Gutierrez Miriam Rebeka
Autoclave, Anaerobic workbench, pH meter, Gassing station, Hungate tubes, Water bath
